question: What do Essential PH-1 owners report about getting help from customer support?

chunks.text: Beware of Essential and how it does business. I am extremely disappointed in the Essential PH-1 phone and the company's support model. I bought the PH-1 phone from Amazon who only sells it via third party resellers as Essential the company does not directly sell their phone through Amazon. Within two weeks, the PH-1 camera stops working so I contacted Essential for support. Keep in mind that Essential sells phones but does not have a phone number to contact them for support. They only communicate through email. I describe the problem to them and they request additional information from me: my name, address, proof of purchase, serial number, etc. After providing them with all the data, they inform me that they will not support me because I bought the phone from a reseller. They said they only support the phone if it is bought directly from Essential and Amazon.

This phone is for people that want a company that will support their device and their customers, and not lock it down. This is the first generation Essential PH-1, and there have been weird quirks and bugs, and that's to be expected, but Essential has done what no other modern device manufacturer does: updates and customer service. That in itself is work the price that's half of what you'd pay for another "flagship" device.

This is really impressive. Essential published the December security update at the very same day as Google did for their Pixel 2 phones. No other company did this. And everything looks extremely promising for future updates - The Essential PH-1 has an open Android 8.0 beta test with detailed instructions for manual installation, covered under warranty. Reports say that the software experience is further improved even in the beta version. - The Essential PH-1 will get hardware abstraction layers (HALs) for much easier and faster updates (Project Treble). While all phones that are released with Android 8 or newer are required to implement Treble, phones updated to Android 8 can choose if they want to support it. Essential is one of only three companies that confirmed Treble support. All the big players will not add support to old phones.

I REALLY wanted to love this phone and I do really appreciate the customer support. The U11 guys never responded when I tried to get it fixed. Essential was super helpful right away! That alone is reason to try them again and if they get the hardware right I certainly will. I'm between 2 and 3 stars on this guy: minus 1 for software and minus 2 for hardware but the support was outstanding and I'm going to give this a solid 3. I'm looking forward to a PH-2 review of 5 starts!
And in the end you'll be holding what the Essential PH-1 was always meant to be. A love letter to the industry, now at half the price. Hope this helps! Take care!

Seriously.) With all this, if there is never a PH-2 made, I will be extremely disappointed. Hopefully, after skipping a cycle, Essential is able to get back on their feet and crank out a successor to the PH-1, with better day-one support and, as difficult as it may be, even further refinement to what I consider to be perhaps the quintessential Android phone. I'll be in line to buy it.

essential ph-1 is subtly elegant piece of technology. The essential ph-1 is subtly elegant piece of technology. The android OS works fast and smooth. It fits excellent in the hand and is a perfect replacement to my Nexus 5x. I have switched between multiple different devices this past month to find a permanent replacement under 500 for my previous phone and so far this seems to be it. I'm looking forward to essential home device when it is launched.

Best looking phone. I own an iPhone 6 and like smart watches that look like a regular watch cause i don’t like the Apple Watch got myself a Fossil watch but couldn’t respond to text so I got the essential ph-1 it’s an amazing phone the camera is good I had to send it back because of connectivity issues The PH-1 is the best looking phone on the market today PERIOD so please Essential make the PH-2 folded hands
